title: FilterSet
description: The one typed filter object shared by map, table, summary, chart and export requests across /api/v1 (FR-002, FR-065). Dimensions 1-20 are the named dimensions from the source requirements (S1 PDF pp. 13-15); processingLevels, datasetTypes, installationDateRange and seasonalityIds are the persona additions named in the technical specification. UNKNOWN VS ABSENT: an absent key means 'no constraint on this dimension'; the sentinel value "unknown" inside a multi-value array explicitly selects records whose value for that dimension is unknown or unset. These are different queries and must never be collapsed (e.g. telemetry:["telemetered"] vs telemetry omitted vs telemetry:["unknown"]). Multi-value arrays are OR within a dimension; dimensions AND together. Values are governed identifiers from the steward vocabulary unless an enum is given inline. Omit a dimension rather than sending an empty array.

distributionSystemIds.description: Dimension 1: distribution system identifiers. OR within, AND against other dimensions.

subgroupIds.description: Dimension 3: subgroup identifiers within a distribution system.

telemetry.description: Dimension 5: telemetry availability, tri-state. "unknown" (telemetry status not established) differs from an absent key (no constraint). "manual" means no telemetry.

observedPropertyIds.description: Dimension 7: observed property identifiers (governed vocabulary: discharge, stage, voltage at v0.1.0).

waterSourceTypeIds.description: Dimension 11: water source type identifiers (surface, ground, storage, ...).

measurementMethodTypeIds.description: Dimension 13: measurement method type identifiers. The steward must decide whether this and dimension 20 (methodTypeIds) are distinct concepts before v0.2.

dataDateRange.description: Dimension 15: available data date range. The mode is mandatory because the source requirement forbids inferring coverage meaning from an ambiguous label: "any-data" selects sites with any data in the period, "complete-coverage" requires full coverage of the period, "available-since" selects sites with data available on or after the start instant. Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC instants.

start.description: Inclusive start instant, half-open interval [start, end).

end.description: Exclusive end instant, half-open interval [start, end).

siteStatusIds.description: Dimension 16: site status identifiers (active, inactive, proposed at v0.1.0).

stateCodes.description: Dimension 17: state code. The Bear River basin spans Utah, Idaho and Wyoming.

aggregationStatisticIds.description: Dimension 19: aggregation statistic identifiers (daily mean, daily total, ...).

methodTypeIds.description: Dimension 20: method type identifiers. Overlaps dimension 13 in the source; steward decision pending.

processingLevels.description: Persona addition: processing level selection (governed vocabulary).

datasetTypes.description: Persona addition: dataset type. Measured, estimated and computed are distinct accounting categories and are never silently summed.

installationDateRange.description: Persona addition (engineering): installation date range. Half-open [start, end); omit a bound to leave it open.

seasonalityIds.description: Persona addition (engineering): operating seasonality. Seasonal sites suppress false missing-data incidents outside the active period.
